title: Prompt placeholder source strings are a shared contract between senders and the server allowlist
answers: prompt registration returns 400 after changing the dummy source
where is the placeholder source for register_prompt defined
keep UI prompt creation in sync with server source allowlist
add a new prompt sender with a source placeholder
body:
Invariant: the placeholder source values used when creating prompt versions must match the server allowlist. The Python senders import their literals from mlflow/prompt/constants.py: _CLIENT_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ("dummy-source") in MlflowClient.register_prompt, and _STORE_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ("prompt-template") in AbstractStore.create_prompt_version. The server accepts exactly the set _PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS built from them.
Enforced by: the imports at both Python call sites and the frozenset in mlflow/prompt/constants.py. The UI literal in mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/prompts/api.ts:RegisteredPromptsApi is not imported and is checked only by a pointer comment.
What breaks if skipped: editing a sender literal without updating the allowlist turns prompt registration into a 400 with no signal at the sender.
Constraints: a new sender must add its placeholder to _PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS, and the UI literal must be edited by hand.
applies: Any code that creates prompt model versions from Python, the store, or the UI.
says: Creating a new prompt from the web interface fails with a bad request error.
Registering prompts through client libraries fails because default source values are rejected.
Ensure creating prompts in the web console matches the server source requirements.
Prompt registration rejects valid templates when the dummy source string does not match.
search: Placeholder source values used when creating prompt model versions must match the server allowlist defined in mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS. Python callers import literals _CLIENT_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER in MlflowClient.register_prompt and _STORE_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER in AbstractStore.create_prompt_version, while the web UI literal in RegisteredPromptsApi is edited manually. Any mismatch between sender placeholder values and the server allowlist causes prompt registration to return a 400 error.
